description: Pioneering basic rights entitlement scheme by Government of Tamil Nadu recognizing the unpaid labor of women and empowering women heads of families with a monthly cash entitlement of Rs 1,000 directly deposited into their bank accounts.
department: Department of Special Programme Implementation, Government of Tamil Nadu
source_ref: Government of Tamil Nadu / KMUT Portal
benefits_summary: Monthly basic income entitlement of Rs 1,000 credited directly into the eligible woman beneficiary's bank account (Rs 12,000/year).

criteria.description: Beneficiary family must hold a valid Smart Family Ration Card issued in Tamil Nadu
criteria.failure_reason: KMUT is an exclusive welfare entitlement for bona fide residents of Tamil Nadu

criteria.description: The applicant must be a female head or adult female member of the household
criteria.failure_reason: Applicant must be an eligible female family head

criteria.description: Applicant must have attained 21 years of age
criteria.failure_reason: Applicant has not attained the minimum qualifying age of 21

criteria.description: Annual household income must be less than or equal to Rs 2,50,000
criteria.failure_reason: Annual family income exceeds the statutory threshold of Rs 2,50,000

documents.document_name: Tamil Nadu Smart Family Card (Ration Card)
documents.description: Smart Card showing household address and listing of family members
documents.issuing_authority: Civil Supplies & Consumer Protection Department, TN

documents.description: Active bank account seeded with NPCI for DBT credit
Domestic electricity service number verifying domestic consumption under 3,600 units/year

scheme_name: Pudhumai Penn Scheme (Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme)
description: Tamil Nadu state initiative to curb girl-child school dropouts and incentivize higher education by providing financial assistance of Rs 1,000 per month to female students who studied from Class 6 to 12 in Tamil Nadu Government Schools until they complete their undergraduate degrees, diplomas, or ITI courses.
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
source_ref: Government of Tamil Nadu Portal / tnsocialwelfare.tn.gov.in
benefits_summary: Direct deposit of Rs 1,000 per month directly into student's personal bank account during the entire duration of the degree/diploma program.

criteria.description: Must be an enrolled higher education student in Tamil Nadu
criteria.failure_reason: Applicant is not studying within Tamil Nadu higher educational institutional network

criteria.description: Scheme is exclusively applicable to female students
criteria.failure_reason: Pudhumai Penn higher education assurance is reserved for girl students

criteria.description: Applicant must currently be an active enrolled college or polytechnic student
criteria.failure_reason: Applicant is not actively enrolled as a full-time student

criteria.description: Student is within customary undergraduate/post-diploma age range of 16-28
criteria.failure_reason: Applicant age is outside the 16-28 collegiate education bracket

documents.description: EMIS certificates certifying continuous schooling in TN Government schools from 6th to 12th standard
Proof of enrollment in recognized Degree/Diploma/ITI college course
Personal bank account in student's sole name linked to Aadhaar

scheme_name: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS)
description: Comprehensive statewide healthcare protection providing cashless hospital treatments up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year for 1,090 surgical procedures, 400 medical procedures, and specialized daycare therapies across designated government and private hospitals in Tamil Nadu.
department: Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
source_ref: Government of Tamil Nadu / Tamil Nadu Health Systems Project (TNHSP)
benefits_summary: Cashless hospitalization and critical therapy coverage up to Rs 5,00,000 per family per year in over 1,500 empaneled hospitals across Tamil Nadu.

criteria.description: Applicant family must be domiciled in Tamil Nadu
criteria.failure_reason: CMCHIS coverage requires domicile within Tamil Nadu

criteria.description: Annual household income must not exceed Rs 1,20,000 as certified by revenue authorities
criteria.failure_reason: Household income exceeds the subsidized CMCHIS threshold of Rs 1,20,000

documents.description: Family card showing members and domicile

documents.document_name: Income Certificate from Village Administrative Officer (VAO) / Tahsildar
documents.description: Proof of annual income under Rs 1,20,000
Smart health card issued at District Kiosks

scheme_name: Dr. Muthulakshmi Reddy Maternity Benefit Scheme (MRMBS)
description: Comprehensive conditional cash transfer and nutritional support scheme to prevent maternal and infant mortality by providing Rs 18,000 financial support and 2 Amma Nutrition Kits worth Rs 4,000 to pregnant women from low-income families delivering in government health facilities.
department: Public Health and Preventive Medicine, Health and Family Welfare Department, TN
source_ref: Government of Tamil Nadu / PICME Portal
benefits_summary: Financial support of Rs 18,000 disbursed across 5 milestones + 2 Amma Nutrition Kits (iron syrup, nutrition mix, dates, ghee, towel).

criteria.description: Beneficiary must be a resident of Tamil Nadu
criteria.failure_reason: Applicant must reside in Tamil Nadu

criteria.description: Beneficiary must be a pregnant female citizen
criteria.failure_reason: Scheme is specifically designed for expectant mothers

criteria.description: Mother must be at least 19 years old at time of registration
criteria.failure_reason: Applicant has not attained the legal minimum maternity benefit age of 19

criteria.description: Priority for low-income and BPL pregnant women
criteria.failure_reason: Household income is above the priority maternity assistance bracket

documents.document_name: PICME (Pregnancy and Infant Cohort Monitoring and Evaluation) 12-Digit RCH ID
documents.description: Mandatory ante-natal registration recorded by Village Health Nurse (VHN)
documents.issuing_authority: Directorate of Public Health & Preventive Medicine, TN

documents.description: Record of mandatory ANC checkups and immunizations

scheme_name: Tamil Nadu Uzhavar Pathukappu Thittam (Farmers' Social Security Scheme)
description: Comprehensive statewide social security scheme enacted through the Tamil Nadu Agricultural Labourers - Farmers (Social Security and Welfare) Act, extending educational scholarships, marriage assistance, maternity benefits, disability aid, accident relief, and monthly old-age pensions to landless agricultural laborers, small farmers, and tenant cultivators in Tamil Nadu.
department: Revenue and Disaster Management Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
source_ref: Government of Tamil Nadu Portal / Commissioner of Land Administration
benefits_summary: Extensive social security including monthly old-age pension (Rs 1,000/mo), accident grant of Rs 1,00,000, education grants up to Rs 6,000/yr for children, and marriage aid up to Rs 10,000.

criteria.description: Must be an agricultural worker or farmer domiciled in Tamil Nadu
criteria.failure_reason: Applicant does not reside within Tamil Nadu jurisdiction

criteria.description: Primary livelihood must be agriculture, farm labor, or tenant farming
criteria.failure_reason: Applicant occupation is not registered as an agricultural cultivator or farm laborer

criteria.description: Member must be between 18 and 65 years of age during active enrollment
criteria.failure_reason: Applicant is outside the 18-65 active member age bracket

criteria.description: Priority for small landholding or landless agricultural households under Rs 1,80,000
criteria.failure_reason: Household income is above the priority agrarian welfare threshold

documents.document_name: Uzhavar Pathukappu Thittam Membership Identity Card
documents.description: Official welfare board card issued by Special Tahsildar (Social Security Schemes)
Proof of family membership and rural address

documents.document_name: VAO Agricultural Laborer Certificate / Chitta / Adangal
documents.description: Certification by Village Administrative Officer verifying agricultural livelihood
Savings bank passbook for direct benefit transfers
